title: Mek|*haste!*
body: Means: Hurry up!|"Mek haste, di bus a leave!"
caption:
Mek haste! 🏃🏾‍♂️💨

When yuh mother seh "mek haste", yuh better move yuh feet 😂 It means hurry up!

Use it inna a sentence: "Mek haste, di bus a leave!" 🚌
